description:
An open-source alternative to Claude Cowork, powered by OpenCode

OpenWork is an extensible, open-source “Claude Work” style system for knowledge workers.
It’s a native desktop app that runs OpenCode under the hood, but presents it as a clean, guided workflow:
- pick a workspace
- start a run
- watch progress + plan updates
- approve permissions when needed
- reuse what works (templates + skills)
The goal: make “agentic work” feel like a product, not a terminal.
Cloud connections unify and desktop recovery gets stronger
- Google Workspace support now runs through Cloud Connect, with working Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, and Microsoft 365 actions.
- Desktop now recovers credentials and cloud sessions more reliably, while startup errors show a recovery screen instead of a blank window.
- Browser and desktop users get native page context menus and right-click menus.
- Launchable openwork-server and AUR binaries ship reliably, and published desktop releases can open to a blank starting point.
- Automation runs, analytics pagination, Gmail draft attachments, and session transcript loading are more dependable.
Full changelog: https://openworklabs.com/docs/changelog · Compare
Windows installers are signed using Microsoft Artifact Signing.
